title: Transition for Inclusive Development in Eastern DRC (TRIDE)
donor: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands (Kigali)
summary: Five-year transition programme in eastern DRC strengthening inclusive economic development for smallholder farmers, market actors and public authorities through integrated water resource management and food security.
beneficiaries: Smallholder farmers, market actors, public authorities

title: Grinding Mill business development — Itang & Terkidi refugee camp, Gambella
summary: Strengthen the livelihoods and self-reliance of refugees and host communities in Itang woreda, Gambella, by developing grinding-mill businesses.

title: Emergency WASH and Cash support for war-affected populations
summary: Three-month emergency response delivering multi-purpose cash assistance and improved access to drinking water and hygiene for conflict-affected populations around Goma, North Kivu.
source_file: Projet Assistance ZOA AVUDS Goma_Project Proposal in English.docx

title: Lifesaving Emergency Shelter/NFI and WASH assistance for IDPs in Tigray
summary: Nine-month emergency intervention addressing the basic needs of conflict-induced IDPs and host communities in Tigray through integrated, gender-sensitive shelter, NFI and WASH assistance.
source_file: ZOA Revised Proposal Tigray Emergency Response 2021-07-27, BHA.pdf

title: We are able! — Co-creating inclusive governance for access to basic resources
donor: Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Power of Voices)
summary: Multi-country civil-society programme co-creating inclusive governance for access to basic resources, leaving no one behind — with a focus on persons with disabilities and food security.
beneficiaries: Persons with disabilities, women, IDPs, ultra-poor, youth
